verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a remote-desktop service that stores account data, session history and logs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency location. The CLI, REST API and portal-management docs cover other capabilities, and the breach discussions are off-topic for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
